name: Rocket Propulsion
description: This course provides an in-depth study of the fundamentals of rocket propulsion, including thermodynamics of the combustion chamber and nozzle. Students analyze solid, liquid, and hybrid propellant systems.

name: Aerodynamics
description: This course explores the principles of aerodynamics and how airflow interacts with wings, airfoils, and other flying bodies. Students study lift, drag, compressible flow, and the aerodynamic design of vehicles.

name: Spacecraft Design
description: This course covers the principles of spacecraft design, including structures, propulsion, thermal control, and power systems. Students apply systems engineering methodologies to design missions.

name: Organic Chemistry
description: An introduction to organic chemistry covering functional groups, reaction mechanisms, and synthesis strategies for carbon-based molecules.
